acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: ### B8. Claude Code hooks degrade on every prompt after each commit, and the fallback names the wrong cause with no remediation - Severity: medium. Core: yes. Votes: go-runtime:cmd 1/1 confirmed; agent-systems 1/2 (disputed as spec-chosen, see D10); FALLBACK messaging 1/1 confirmed. Reported by: go-runtime:cmd, agent-systems; storage's related finding was rejected. - Locations: `cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go:359-366` (synchronous in-memory build on snapshot miss), `cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go:57-82,108` (1.5 s work budget), `host_adapter.go:628-635` (`dogfood-event-deadline` classified expected, no `systemMessage`), `host_adapter.go:597-601` (remediation argv only on the success path). - Failure (reproduced three times on a 4.3k-file repo, load 33-52): after any content commit every UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart and PreCompact returns the 173-byte `FALLBACK degraded: ...dogfood-event-deadline` until someone reruns `corvint index --if-stale`; the text blames the deadline, not the stale snapshot, and the user never sees it. This session's own hooks show it. The verifier who refuted the agent-systems version agrees the behaviour is real and points to IDX-SNAP-V0-012 and decision 0049 as the owner's choice. - Fix (minimum for rc.1): decide the miss in O(ms) and return a distinct `index-snapshot-stale` code with the exact argv in trusted text; promote a repeated expected degradation to one user-visible `systemMessage`. Longer term: refresh snapshots from the explicit write commands (`adopt`, `dogfood begin/verify/finish`, opt-in post-commit) or serve the parent-tree snapshot plus a dirty overlay. Needs a spec amendment if the O(ms) decision replaces the in-budget build. - Known ticket: none (V1-0264 is adjacent).

completion.reason: Verified at 2ae988a3: Hook events name a stale snapshot and its refresh argv, and a snapshot-miss build the recorded cost cannot fit is skipped; the build-cost record is confined and bounded. Completion follows owner acceptance of IDX-SNAP-V0-012 and the AHI amendment.
